name: Saihate ni Okuru Hana
source:
A world where magic, rediscovered from ancient times, has become an integral part of daily life.
Libra, a delivery courier by trade, accepts a request to deliver a bouquet to a town at the easternmost tip of the continent.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12205]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界里，从远古时代重新发现的魔法已经成为日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。
天秤座是一名贸易快递员，接受了将花束运送到大陆最东端的一个城镇的请求。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12205]Novelgame[/url]]
